name: default-marquee
title: Default Marquee
description: Two horizontal strips of testimonial cards loop endlessly, one drifting left and the other right. Each card carries a coloured avatar dot, a name, a handle and a short quote, and hover freezes the motion.
use: You want a dense wall of short customer quotes to keep moving without a carousel control.
avoid: Quotes come from six hardcoded reviews, and constant motion makes a quiet page harder to read.
a11y: Motion never stops except on hover and cannot be paused by keyboard; avatar dots have no text alternative. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a near-black field, two rows of dark rounded review cards with a faint blue glow along their base. Each card has a small coloured circle avatar, a bold name, a grey handle and two lines of white quote text. Cards are clipped and faded at both screen edges.
behaves: Both rows scroll continuously in opposite directions and loop without a visible seam. Hovering any card freezes its strip so a quote can be read; moving away restarts the drift. Fade masks hide the cut ends at each side.
customise: The review list, names, handles, quotes and avatar colours live in a local array, so edit it there. Strip speed, direction and fade colours are set through class names.
weight: light: A handful of cards on two CSS-driven strips plus one noise overlay.
